sampling.method: Select min(128,total row groups) distinct group indices floor(i*(groups-1)/(n-1)), then offsets0,floor(nrows/3),floor(2*nrows/3),nrows-1 in each group; deduplicate local IDs. Samples selected solely from immutable local release before any GEE feature retrieval.
sampling.local_extra_ids: Hylak_id1..10 for lake layers and GOID1..10 forFFR; absent local IDs are reported, not substituted.
sampling.grwl_spatial_requests: Group at most8 small rectangles per MultiPolygon query around first coordinate of each sample source part. Half-size0.0001degree; split longitude wrap at dateline. Pagination must terminate. Extra neighboring GEE features are retained/count-reported but not treated as targeted validation.
sampling.selection_claim: Systematic global coverage, not statistical random sampling or exhaustive feature parity. Report actual sampled countries/continents/source tiles and coordinate bounds.

global_counts.requirement: Actual synchronous Collection.size result must equal immutable local Parquet row count. Metadata-described counts alone do not pass.

matching.lakes: Hylak_id; exactly one GEE feature per requested ID; missing/duplicate IDs fail. Never equate GEE system:index with local FGDB OBJECTID.
matching.free-flowing-rivers: GOID, exactly one per requested ID.
matching.grwl-raw: Original lon,lat rounded only to binary64 plus segmentID and segmentInd, with occurrence multiplicity retained. Never join only onsegmentID. Coincident complete keys require exact attribute/geometry multisets and explicitly disallow individual identity claims. Spatial retrieval is independent of these attribute values.
matching.extra_properties: Record GEE extras separately; local derived bbox,source_row,source_tile,feature_id,width_valid and source FGDB OBJECTID are excluded with explicit reasons.

attributes.mapping: Exact names, unique case-insensitive aliases; additionally explicit producer/GEE aliases for raw elev_m/elev and geometry-derived Shape_Length/Shape_Leng. No heuristic fuzzy matching, scale/unit changes or dropping failing science fields.
attributes.integers: Finite JSON number with exact integral value; bool or numeric string fails.
attributes.float32: GEE finite number must round to exactly the source binary32 value; report float64 differences separately.
attributes.decimal128: Compare GEE binary64 to correctly rounded decimal source, tolerance max(0.5e-18,2*max ulp); source decimal precision remains untouched.
attributes.nulls: Local null agrees only with explicit null or absent per-feature property; zero and empty string never substitute. Every required non-null source cell requires a numeric/string property of correct type.
attributes.strings: Exact Unicode value; no whitespace normalization.
attributes.geometry_derived_fields: Compare retained source Shape_Length/Shape_Area when GEE has an unambiguous corresponding property; report absent fields as coverage gaps, never as passed comparisons.

geometry.strict: Promote singleton Point/LineString/Polygon to equivalent multipart forms, normalize ring direction/start and component order, require equal structure and coordinates within1e-8degrees. Report geometry type changes separately. No repair, simplification, snapping or projection in strict test.
geometry.diagnostic: Separately measure WGS84 geodesic displacement for aligned normalized coordinate arrays; maximum<=1m. If structure differs, report it and only compute a local AEQD Hausdorff diagnostic for <=5000vertices per geometry. Diagnostic results never erase strict failure.
geometry.fail_closed: Missing/empty/non-finite geometry fails. Uncomputed large-geometry diagnostics remain incomplete. No geometry result implies independent scientific accuracy.

Report attribute and geometry outcomes separately; documented geometry diagnostics can establish bounded difference but cannot make strict parity pass.
